messages:
Rina (Marketing): Hey folks — final deck + short post for the launch. Need a tightly scoped bench deliverable we can cite in the blog and webinar.
Diego (Data Eng): What exactly do you need from runtime? raw outputs, perf numbers, both?
Rina (Marketing): Both. Minimal artifact set: raw_samples per prompt, CSV of percentiles (p50/p95/p99), cold vs warm measurements, and a one-line provenance string we can paste in the blog (host, commit, date). Also SHA256 checksums for the files.
Jia (Eng Runtime): OK. Can do. Which prompts and model configs are in scope? Also want to know target batch sizes and warmup policy.
Rina (Marketing): Six canonical prompts: a short sign-up prompt, a one-paragraph summarization, a tiny code complete (20 tokens), a clarification-turn multi-turn prompt, SQL->NL translation, and one long document ~1200 tokens. Models: "redwood-3b.fp16", "redwood-3b.q4_0", and the small fallback variant. Batch configs: show BATCH=1 (latency) and BATCH=16 (throughput). Warmup: 3 iterations for warm traces.
Harper (ProdEng): Add acceptance rules: runs should have token-count-aligned outputs within 2% across repeats for determinism. If >5% variance in p95, we'll record driver/kernel versions and re-run.
Diego (Data Eng): For the blog we want per-response cost and per-1k-token cost. Also include tokenizationdifferences if quantized variant changes tokenization length (rare but important).
Jia (Eng Runtime): Noted. We'll include per-response and per-1000-token cost. For reproducibility: we'll use random_seed=1234 for main runs and save RNG state. We'll produce: raw_samples/<variant>.jsonl, perf/<variant>-hist.csv, perf/<variant>-tail.png, manifest.json (run_cmd, env, seed, commit, host, sha256s).
Rina (Marketing): perfect. Put artifacts in s3://redwood-marketing/launch/benchifacts/2549876543/ and mark signed=true if you can sign the manifest. If not, mark signed=false.
Jia (Eng Runtime): We'll attempt GPG sign with our release key. timeline: smoke run tonight (30 queries per prompt) and full run tomorrow morning (300 queries per prompt). Will include logs in the tarball. ci-bot: will you auto-upload artifacts?
ci-bot: upload job queued — will post presigned links to this thread on completion.
Diego (Data Eng): One more: can you include a tiny logits dump (first 32 tokens) for the signup prompt for regression checks? We use that in the automated smoke.
Jia (Eng Runtime): yes — logits_dump/<variant>-signup.jsonl (first 32 tokens). Also will tag samples with coldstart=true/false.
Rina (Marketing): For the webinar narrative, we may show cold vs warm bars side-by-side. Please ensure coldstart timestamps are clearly labeled in the CSV.
Harper (ProdEng): Also include memory RSS peak and GPU utilization traces. If quantized variant has lower mem but higher latency for some prompts, note that in manifest as a caveat.
Diego (Data Eng): Running the smoke now (BATCH=1). Posting quick diffs in ~10m.
ci-bot: smoke upload complete: https://s3.example/redwood-marketing/launch/benchifacts/2549876543/smoke/ (logs + quick_manifest.json)
Jia (Eng Runtime): smoke looks sane — small logits differences on code-complete for q4_0 but within tolerances. Kickoff full runs now. Will attach final manifest + signed sha256s when done.
Rina (Marketing): Thank you! Ideally have final artifacts by EOD tomorrow so I can lock slides. If any regression appears, ping here and we'll discuss adjusting narrative. :sparkles:
Diego (Data Eng): Got it. I'll consume JSONL -> slide summary once artifacts in S3.
Jia (Eng Runtime): final upload complete; presigned URL posted by ci-bot. Manifest signed:false (key rotation delay). Manifest notes: commit=bb12ff, host=gpu-17, runtime=v2.8. See manifest.marketing_blurb: "Runs run with 3 warmups; quantized outputs may have micro-differences; seed=1234."
ci-bot: artifacts: https://s3.example/redwood-marketing/launch/benchifacts/2549876543/ (manifest.json, raw_samples/, perf/, logits_dump/)
Rina (Marketing): grabbing assets now — will flag if anything odd. Thanks everyone!
